effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Paledramon] or [Hexeblaumon] in its name and 1 card with the [Ice-Snow] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Trash the top digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
